## Total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in three species

Here, I calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain, in three species (human, pig, mouse), based on data from <https://www.proteinatlas.org/humanproteome/brain>.

```{r}
gene_nums <- list(180, 83, 57, 110, 109, 31, 45, 114, 55, 60, 98, 47)
sum <- 0

for (x in gene_nums){
  sum <- sum + x
}

print(sum)
```
